CAP 100.title: Introduction to Writing and Research in the Social Sciences and the Humanities
CAP 100.description: Analysis of and practice in academic research and writing in the social sciences and the humanities. Restricted to students in the Coordinated Arts Program. Credits count toward the Writing Component of the Faculty of Arts Writing and Research Requirement.

CAP 101.title: Introduction to Reading and Research in Literary, Cultural, and Media Studies
CAP 101.description: Applications of research and writing skills in the context of literary, cultural, and media analysis. Topics integrate CAP stream themes and vary each year. Restricted to students in the Coordinated Arts Program.
